envelope.description: Family infrastructure and the repository families

body.title: Family infrastructure and the repository families
body.summary: Commit the op-table schema builder first (required, optional, exactly-one-of, at-least-one groups, enums, expression strings), the output union with the literal op, and the tab and config parsers, as their own commit with unit tests; then add gh_issue_manage, gh_pr_manage, gh_release_asset, gh_repo_manage, gh_run_manage, gh_workflow_manage and gh_project_manage with their classes and limits, and register them.
acceptanceChecks: every op builds the argv the LLD table gives for its fields and rejects a field the op does not accept
release download rejects an input with none of tag, pattern and archive, and set-default needs exactly one of repository, view, unset
project link and unlink carry no --format and every project op returns op, ok, target, message

tests.name: gh-parsers.test.ts: tab-column parser and config list parser on the fixtures
gh-op-schema.test.ts: requiredness, exclusive pairs, at-least-one groups, enums and expression strings of the builder
gh-family-tools.test.ts: issue, pr, release asset, repo, run, workflow and project ops build the argv the table gives and return the literal op
gh-inputs.test.ts: release download requires a tag, a non-empty pattern list or an archive; set-default needs exactly one of repository, view, unset
